Name: Suns Out Guns Out - Sleeveless Shirts
Author: whutupribs
Description:
Works for male and female farmers. Requires Content Patcher.

Should be compatible with most clothing mods.

NOT compatible with any mods that alter the base Farmer sprites.

[size=5][color=#ffe599]Now includes a "long sleeves" option![/color][/size]
[u][b]
Installation:[/b][b]
[/b][/u]To install, unzip directly into your StardewValley/Mods folder and enjoy!


[u][b]Usage:

[/b][/u]You can choose the type of sleeves you want  by accessing the config.json file included. There are separate settings for male and female farmers. All you have to do is replace the default setting of "none" with one of these three options: "none", "short" or "long".
